name: 9router-app

scripts.dev:server: cp -r .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static 2>/dev/null; cp -r public .next/standalone/public 2>/dev/null; cp custom-server.js .next/standalone/; mkdir -p .next/standalone/node_modules/open-sse && cp -r open-sse/. .next/standalone/node_modules/open-sse/ && printf '{"name":"open-sse","version":"0.0.0","main":"index.js"}' > .next/standalone/node_modules/open-sse/package.json; cd .next/standalone && DATA_DIR="$HOME/.9router" PORT=20129 node custom-server.js
scripts.build:standalone: pnpm run build && rm -rf standalone-dist && cp -r .next/standalone standalone-dist && cp -r .next/static standalone-dist/.next/static && cp -r public standalone-dist/public && cp custom-server.js standalone-dist/ && cd standalone-dist && echo 'node-linker=hoisted' > .npmrc && pnpm install --prod --no-frozen-lockfile && mkdir -p node_modules/open-sse && cp -r ../open-sse/. node_modules/open-sse/ && printf '{"name":"open-sse","version":"0.0.0","main":"index.js"}' > node_modules/open-sse/package.json

comment_better_sqlite3: kept in optionalDependencies so npm install doesn't fail on systems without build tools — sql.js is used as fallback at runtime
